about:
# Bag Bloat

Bag Bloat checks the quest items in your bags and bank on WoW Forever and tells you which
ones you can delete.

Every quest item gets one of these labels, in its tooltip and in the Bag Bloat
window:

| Label | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Quest done | The item starts a quest you already completed. Safe to delete. |
| Gray quest | The item starts a quest that is gray for your level. Safe to delete. |
| No quest in log | A quest item that no quest in your log uses, often left over from a quest you finished or dropped. Check before deleting. |
| Starts a quest | The item starts a quest you have not done and that still gives experience. |
| Hidden quest | The item starts a quest that has no name, which is how the game hides a quest. Keep it. |
| Secret quest | The item belongs to a known secret quest chain, such as the Dawn Waker chain the Skyborne ring starts, the Stone Key, the Bloody Map, the Coldflame Saber, Lyn the Ignored, Ta'shkal or the Malignant Root. Always kept. |
| Kept by you | You chose Keep for the item in the window. It stays kept unless a quest in your log needs it. |
| On quest | A quest in your log needs the item. That includes an item the quest handed you to deliver. |

An item you hide from the window is labeled Hidden by you. It gets no tooltip line and no bag icon.

In your bags, each quest item also gets a corner icon: a green check when you
have the quest or already completed it, a red X when the quest is gray or no quest in your log uses the item, and a
question mark when it starts a quest you have not picked up or belongs to a hidden
or secret quest. This works in the game's own bags and bank and in EllesmereUI
Bags and its bank.

Hold Alt while hovering a quest item for the quest ID, its status, your
objective progress and the item ID.

Open the window with `/bloat`, `/bagbloat` or the addon compartment button next
to the minimap. Click a row to pick the item up, then click outside your bags to
delete it through the game's own confirmation. Shift-click a row to link the
item in chat. Right-click a row to keep the item, hide it, or delete it. Bag
Bloat deletes an item only when you click Delete, one item per click, and only
items marked safe to delete.

The window groups items as follows, in this order:

- Ready to turn in: items for quests in your log that you can turn in now.
- Your current zone, then the other zones A to Z, by the zone of each item's quest.
- Not in your quest log: items no quest in your log uses.
- Safe to delete.
- Hidden by you. This group starts folded.

An item that starts a quest you have not picked up is listed under the zone
where that quest is turned in, for the 160 classic quests the bundled table
knows. The table is built from pfQuest data (MIT, see THIRD-PARTY.md) by
`tools/gen_quest_zones.py`. Other quest-starting items stay under Not in your
quest log.

Click a group's header to fold or unfold it; it remembers which groups you
folded. The search box at the top right filters the list by item name, quest
title or zone, and shows every match while it has text. Escape clears the text,
then closes the window.

Bank items stay in the window from your last bank visit, marked (bank), so you
can see them away from the bank. When you enter a zone that has quest items for
it in your bank, Bag Bloat prints one chat line about it. While the bank is
open, Bank on a group's header moves its items to the bank and Take moves them
back to your bags.

The Delete button on the Safe to delete group asks twice. The first click
changes it to Sure?, and each click after that deletes the next item in the
group, one per click. It disarms 10 seconds after your last click or when you
close the window. The By zone box switches back to one list. Drag the
bottom-right corner to resize the window; it remembers its size. The window
uses the Expressway font when EllesmereUI or SharedMedia has it.

When your bags fill up and some quest items in them are safe to delete, Bag
Bloat prints one chat line saying how many, at most every two minutes.

Keep and hide choices are saved per character.

## Why an item has its label

`/bloat why` opens a box with what the game reports for one item and how each
rule decided its label and zone. Type `/bloat why` while hovering an item in
your bags or in the window, or add an item link or item ID after `why`. Press
Ctrl+C to copy the text, for example into a bug report. It does not work in
combat.

## Releasing

Pushing a tag publishes: GitHub Actions runs the BigWigs packager, which uploads
to CurseForge once the TOC has `## X-Curse-Project-ID` and the repository has a
`CF_API_KEY` secret.

```
git tag v0.1.0
git push origin v0.1.0
```

# Bag Bloat

## [v0.3.6](https://github.com/Medalink/BagBloat/tree/v0.3.6) (2026-11-21)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/Medalink/BagBloat/compare/v0.3.5...v0.3.6) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/Medalink/BagBloat/releases)

- Narrow the delivery-item rules after review  
    The summary rule now uses only the last word of the item's name, and a tie  
    held up by a fight is dropped instead of sweeping up loot.  
    What changes  
    - Core.lua OwnerInLog: any shared word -> the name's last word only.  
      "Stormwind Orders" no longer matches "Return to Stormwind".  
    - Core.lua TieGiven: an accept older than ACCEPT\_LIFE (10 s) ties nothing.  
    - OFFER\_LIFE 300 -> 120 s.  
    - AddWords -> AddSummary, which reuses the word tables between log reads.  
    Unchanged on purpose  
    - Both rules still only move an item to On quest.  
    - BagBloatCharDB.given entries for quests that left the log while the addon  
      was off stay; they are ignored, since the rule checks the log.  
    Verification  
    - luajit parses all seven files; luacheck 0 errors, 7 old long-line warnings.  
    - Word rule on real strings: "Beguiler's Blade" -> blade, "Marshal McBride's  
      Documents" -> document, "Stormwind Orders", "Ring of Thorns" and  
      "Key of Ur" -> no match.  
    - Not run in game.  
- Mark an item a quest hands you to deliver as On quest  
    Beguiler's Blade, handed over on accepting The Goblin Trader, showed the  
    red X and "No quest in your log uses this". The quest log lists no  
    objective for a delivery item and the item starts no quest, so nothing  
    matched it to the quest.  
    What changes  
    - Core.lua: a quest item that was not in the bags when a quest was offered  
      (QUEST\_DETAIL) and is there after the accept (QUEST\_ACCEPTED) is saved in  
      BagBloatCharDB.given[itemID] = questID and reads On quest while that quest  
      is in the log. QUEST\_TURNED\_IN and QUEST\_REMOVED drop the entry.  
    - Core.lua: for items already carried, a quest with no item objective also  
      claims a quest item whose name shares a word of four letters or more with  
      the quest's summary line ("blade" here).  
    - OwnerOfObjectiveItem -> OwnerInLog, which also says how the quest was found.  
    - /bloat why adds "came with quest", "log quests with no item objective"  
      and "owner in log".  
    Unchanged on purpose  
    - Both new rules only ever move an item to On quest. Neither can make an  
      item safe to delete.  
    - An item no rule matches still shows No quest in log with the red X.  
    Verification  
    - luajit parses all seven files; luacheck 0 errors, 7 old long-line warnings.  
    - The word rule run on the real strings: "Beguiler's Blade" matches the  
      quest's summary on "blade"; "Ring of Thorns" does not match "Bring ...  
      during".  
    - Not run in game.  
- Tell a refused delete from a slow cursor, and disarm Delete in the flat list  
    A delete whose cursor has not cleared yet is no longer reported as refused: the slot is checked half a second later and the chat line says which happened.  
    What changes  
    - Core: DeleteRecord checks the slot 0.5 s after an unclear delete, marks the item refused only if it is still there, then refreshes the window  
    - Core: a save from before warbank existed drops its bank list once  
    - Window: the flat list disarms Delete  
    Unchanged on purpose  
    - The delete itself still runs only inside the click; the timer only reads the slot  
    Verification  
    - luajit -bl parses all seven Lua files; luacheck 0 errors, 7 old warnings  
    - Not run in game  
- Fix what the review found in Delete and the bank memory  
    Delete no longer works on a folded group, so it cannot remove items you cannot see, and the bank memory survives a bank that is only partly readable.  
    What changes  
    - Window: Delete is off with "Open the group first" on a folded group; it disarms on fold, on search and when no safe group is listed; the click rescans before picking its target  
    - Core: DeleteRecord checks the cursor after DeleteCursorItem, puts a refused item back and stops offering it this session  
    - Core: bank memory split into bank (character tabs) and warbank (account tabs); each is rewritten only when its own tabs are readable and at least 1 s after the bank opened  
    - Core: rescans run while the bank is open even with the window and bags closed  
    - Core: scans made for the chat lines repaint the bag icons; bags-full line uses a proper singular and plural  
    - Window: Bank and Take use the banker check, summary anchors on one line; Why: only item tooltips count  
    Unchanged on purpose  
    - One Escape still closes the window, the menu and the why box together  
    - No scan when the bank closes: the game may no longer report its contents then  
    Verification  
    - luajit -bl parses all seven Lua files; luacheck 0 errors, 7 old warnings  
    - Not run in game  
- List quest-starting items under the zone their quest is turned in  
    An item that starts a quest you have not picked up now shows under a zone instead of "Not in your quest log", for the 160 classic quests the new table knows.  
    What changes  
    - QuestZones.lua: ns.QUEST\_AREA, questID -> AreaTable ID, 160 quests in 35 zones  
    - tools/gen\_quest\_zones.py builds it from pfQuest (MIT, commit 104f356) and the client's ItemSparse; tools is left out of the package  
    - THIRD-PARTY.md carries the pfQuest licence; README and CurseForge description credit it  
    Unchanged on purpose  
    - Quests pfQuest cannot place stay unzoned: 33 with no turn-in spot, 17 whose turn-in NPC appears in several zones (the Darkmoon Faire)  
    - Quest-starting items with quest IDs of 10000 and up stay under Not in your quest log  
    Verification  
    - Two generator runs gave the same file; every zone id has the same name in pfQuest and the Forever AreaTable  
    - luajit -bl parses QuestZones.lua  
    - Not run in game  
- Drop the menu's key handler and stop IsHere allocating  
    Escape with the row menu open now closes the menu and the window together, as the other special frames do. Checking whether a zone is the one you are in no longer builds a table per zone group on each refresh.  
    What changes  
    - Menu.lua: removed EnableKeyboard, SetPropagateKeyboardInput and the OnKeyDown handler added in the window change; BagBloatMenu closes through UISpecialFrames only. This corrects that commit's note that Escape closes only the menu.  
    - Core.lua: ns.IsHere reads the map name through a per-mapID cache, so C\_Map.GetMapInfo runs once per map instead of once per zone group per refresh.  
    Unchanged on purpose  
    - The menu still closes on a press outside it and when the window hides.  
    - Which zone names count as "here".  
    Verification  
    - luajit -bl exits 0 for Core, Marks, Skin, Window, Menu and Why.  
    - luacheck --std lua51 --no-global --no-unused-args: 0 errors, the 7 old long-line warnings.  
    - No non-ASCII bytes; Core.lua is 901 lines.  
    - Not run in game.  
- Document the new window features, Delete and /bloat why  
    The README and the CurseForge description now match the window. They say Bag Bloat deletes only when you click Delete, one item per click, and only items marked safe to delete.  
    What changes  
    - Kept by you and Hidden by you labels.  
    - Window: group order with Ready to turn in, folding group headers, the search box, bank items kept in the list from your last visit, the zone chat line, right-click Keep, Hide and Delete, and the Delete button that asks twice.  
    - The bags-full chat line and /bloat why.  
    - "Bag Bloat never deletes anything itself" is replaced with what is true now.  
    Unchanged on purpose  
    - The label table, bag icon notes and the Alt-hover details.  
    - Nothing says where the zone data c

## [v0.3.5](https://github.com/Medalink/BagBloat/tree/v0.3.5) (2026-11-21)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/Medalink/BagBloat/compare/v0.3.4...v0.3.5) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/Medalink/BagBloat/releases)

- Make the /bloat window resizable and skin it in Signal graphite  
    The window resizes from a grip at its bottom-right corner and remembers its size. Every Blizzard control in it is replaced by a flat one in the Meda Signal graphite colors: close X, By zone box, Bank and Take buttons, and a thin scrollbar. Verdict and item quality colors stay as they were.  
    What changes  
    - Window: SetResizable, bounds 320x260 to 900x1200, BagBloatDB.size saved and restored  
    - Window: plain ScrollFrame plus a 4px Slider scrollbar, wheel scrolls one row  
    - Window: color table C copied from the Meda palette; flat close, checkbox, buttons, grip  
    - Window: ns.ApplyFont takes a size; Expressway uses Meda role sizes  
    - README and CurseForge description: one line on resizing  
    Unchanged on purpose  
    - Core.lua and Marks.lua; the game's tooltip keeps its own look  
    - Saved position format; a missing size falls back to 380x440  
    Verification  
    - luajit -bl parses Window.lua; luacheck 0 errors, 7 old warnings  
    - Independent Sonnet review: no blockers; its 1 bug and 2 nits fixed  
    - Not run in game

## [v0.3.4](https://github.com/Medalink/BagBloat/tree/v0.3.4) (2026-11-21)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/Medalink/BagBloat/compare/v0.3.3...v0.3.4) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/Medalink/BagBloat/releases)

- Group the /bloat window by quest zone, with Bank and Take per group  
    The window lists quest items under the zone of their quest, current zone first, so you can see what to carry and what to bank. While the bank is open, each group's Bank and Take buttons move its items one at a time. The By zone box brings back the single list. Text uses Expressway when EllesmereUI or SharedMedia has it.  
    What changes  
    - Core: logZone from quest log headers (map name fallback); rec.zone per record  
    - Core: ns.MoveRecords(recs, toBank), 0.08 s per item, bank and banker checked before every UseContainerItem  
    - Window: zone, "Not in your quest log" and "Safe to delete" groups; By zone checkbox (BagBloatDB.byZone, default on)  
    - Window: ns.ApplyFont for Expressway; TOC OptionalDeps adds EllesmereUI  
    - README and CurseForge description: window lines for groups, buttons, font  
    Unchanged on purpose  
    - Verdicts, bag icons and tooltips  
    - Flat list behaves as before with By zone off  
    Verification  
    - luajit -bl parses Core.lua and Window.lua; luacheck 0 errors, 8 old warnings  
    - Independent Sonnet review: no blockers; its 2 bugs and 4 nits fixed  
    - Not run in game

- Mark unused quest items No quest in log again, not Hidden quest  
    v0.3.1 kept every quest item that no quest in your log uses as "Hidden quest", so ordinary leftovers all showed a question mark and "Keep it". They go back to "No quest in log" with a red X and "Check before deleting".  
    What changes  
    - Classify: an unmatched quest item returns orphan instead of hidden  
    - VERDICTS: orphan restored (order 3, mark x); hidden tip now "Starts a hidden quest with no name. Keep it."  
    - README and CurseForge description: No quest in log line back, Hidden quest narrowed, red X covers it  
    Unchanged on purpose  
    - The 27 secret quest items stay kept whatever the game reports  
    - A quest-starting item whose quest has no name stays Hidden quest  
    Verification
